caption_used: Три кръгови диаграми, представящи разпределението на предприятията, заетостта и нетния оборот по отрасли — индустрия, строителство, търговия и други услуги — за 2021 г. В първата диаграма (Number of Enterprises) индустрията заема 12%, строителството — 8%, търговията — 27%, а другите услуги — 53%. По отношение на заетостта (Number of Persons Employed), индустрията е с дял от 51%, строителството — 9%, като търговията надвишава другите услуги с дялове съответно 21% и 19%. При нетния оборот (Turnover) индустрията и търговията имат приблизително равни дялове от по 31%, като строителството представлява около 10% (3,2 трилиона), а другите услуги — 28%.

The figure presents three pie charts comparing the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover across four sectors—industry, construction, trade, and other services—for the year 2021. Each chart contains four sectors, visually distinguished by different colors: orange for industry, blue for construction, red for trade, and purple for other services. The first chart, representing the number of enterprises, shows "Other Services" with the largest share at 61% (19.0 mln), followed by "Industry" at 12% (3.7 mln), "Trade" at 19% (5.9 mln), and "Construction" at 8% (2.4 mln). The second chart, illustrating the number of persons employed, indicates "Industry" as the dominant sector with 51% (80.2 mln), followed by "Trade" at 21% (33.0 mln), "Other Services" at 19% (29.5 mln), and "Construction" at 9% (13.4 mln). The third chart, depicting turnover, shows "Industry" and "Trade" with approximately equal shares of 31% (10.6 tln each), "Other Services" at 28% (9.9 tln), and "Construction" at 10% (3.8 tln). A legend at the bottom of the figure identifies each sector with its corresponding color. The segments within each chart do not appear to be arranged in any specific order.

The third chart, "Turnover," shows "Industry" and "Trade" both at 31%, "Other Services" at 28%, and "Construction" at 10%. Each sector is represented by a distinct color: orange for industry, blue for construction, red for trade, and purple for other services. A legend is provided at the bottom of the figure, and absolute values are included within each segment of the pie charts.
